title: Intra-uterine Injection of Human Chorionic Gonadotrophin (hCG) Before Embryo Transfer
brief_summary: Chorionic gonadotrophins (hCG) play an important role in implantation. The aim of the study is to evaluate the effect of intrauterine injection of hCG before embryo transfer in IVF/ICSI on the implantation and pregnancy rates. The rational is that intrauterine hCG injection will attract regulatory T cells and improve implantation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* male factor infertility
* normal female hormonal profile
* normal uterine cavity

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous ICSI failure
* endometriosis
* azoospermia
